presets.description: MiracleIn v3.0 — uncensored NSFW fine-tune of FLUX.2 Klein 9B for generation and editing. Same Flux 2 stack (Qwen3-8B encoder + Flux 2 VAE); tuned for 12 steps at CFG 1.1.

requirements.notes: MiracleIn v3.0 uncensored fine-tune of FLUX.2 Klein 9B. Flux 2 DiT fp8 (diffusion_models) + Qwen3-8B encoder (clip\, 12288-dim) + Flux 2 VAE. Native Flux 2: Flux2Scheduler + SamplerCustomAdvanced + CFGGuider cfg 1.1 + zeroed negative, euler, ~12 steps (per the model's embedded workflow). Klein base is NON-COMMERCIAL license.

image.description: RETIRED 2026-08-30 - cannot be installed automatically any more. The author put Civitai's paid access on this checkpoint on 2026-08-27, and applied it to every version of the model, so there is no free build to point at. Downloading it now costs 10,000 Buzz. SimpliGen reads Civitai's payment refusal as a rejected API key, so the installer asks for your key again, saves it happily, and never starts the download - an endless loop rather than an error. Nothing is wrong with your key. The preset itself still works if you already own the file: buy or otherwise obtain miracleinNSFWGeneration_30Bf16Fp8.safetensors (8.46 GB, model 2453960, version 2986788), drop it in your diffusion_models folder, and follow retired/README.md to install this preset by hand.
